insights.one_liner: European arm of Chinese renewable energy equipment maker Sungrow, a recognised visa sponsor with an English-language data internship in Amsterdam.

culture.text: Makes inverters and energy storage equipment; the European arm is based in Munich with about 757 people on LinkedIn.
Staff mostly come from electrical engineering, business and energy backgrounds, with schools like TU Munich and RWTH Aachen.
Main functions are sales, operations, IT, engineering and business development.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Sungrow Benelux B.V.
Its one current opening, a data and analytics internship in Amsterdam, does not ask for Dutch.
Operates in more than 100 countries with 20+ international subsidiaries.

growth.text: Strengthened its partnership with be.storaged on gigawatt-hour-scale battery storage projects.
